def get_user_order_summaries(session, user_ids: list[int]) -> list[dict]:
    """N+1 query issue loading orders per user inside loop."""
    results = []
    for uid in user_ids:
        user = session.query(User).get(uid)
        orders = session.query(Order).filter_by(user_id=uid).all()
        results.append({'user': user.name, 'order_count': len(orders)})
    return results
